fields.help_en:
The component list. Elements are arranged from bottom to top in order.
<notice>This parameter is valid and required when Episode.N.EpisodeType is set to Component.
</notice>

 When the node type is Resource, this indicates that the component is bound to the video source and switches synchronously
fields.help_zh:
组件列表。按照元素顺序由下而上排列。
<notice>当Episode.N.EpisodeType为Component时，本参数有用且必传。
</notice>

 当节点类型为Resource时，表示组件与视频源绑定并同步切换
fields.name: component_id

fields.help_en: The end time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC). This parameter is required. If not specified, MissingParameter is returned
fields.help_zh: 结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。必填，不填时返回 MissingParameter
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en:
The node type. Valid values: 
         
Resource: video source. If you select Resource, you must also set the request parameters Episode.N.ResourceId and Episode.N.SwitchType.
Component: component. If you select Component, you must also set the request parameter Episode.N.ComponentId.N.



When Resource is selected and the referenced resource contains a VodUrl (video-on-demand file), EndTime - StartTime cannot exceed the actual playback duration (in seconds) of the VOD file. Otherwise, InvalidParameter.EndTime is returned
fields.help_zh:
节点类型。 
         
Resource：视频源。如果选择Resource类型，必须同时设置请求参数Episode.N.ResourceId和Episode.N.SwitchType。
Component：组件。 如果选择Component类型，必须同时设置请求参数Episode.N.ComponentId.N。



当 选择Resource 且所引用资源包含 VodUrl（点播文件）时，EndTime - StartTime 不能超过该 VOD 文件的实际播放时长（秒级），否则返回 InvalidParameter.EndTime
fields.name: episode_type

fields.help_en:
The video source ID.
<notice>This parameter is valid and required when Episode.N.EpisodeType is set to Resource.
</notice>  
 This parameter is not applicable when Episode.N.EpisodeType is set to Component.

If you added the video source by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/60250.html, check the ResourceId value returned by the AddCasterVideoResource operation
fields.help_zh:
视频源ID。
<notice>当Episode.N.EpisodeType为Resource时，本参数有用且必传。
</notice>  
 当Episode.N.EpisodeType为Component时，本参数不可用。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/60250.html添加导播台视频源，请查看AddCasterVideoResource接口调用返回的参数ResourceId值。
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC). This parameter is required. If not specified, MissingParameter is returned
fields.help_zh: 起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。必填，不填时返回MissingParameter
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en:
The switch policy. Valid values:
<notice>This parameter is valid only when Episode.N.EpisodeType is set to Resource.
</notice>
         
TimeFirst: time first. Live video sources can only use the time first policy. 
ContentFirst: content first
fields.help_zh:
切换策略。取值：
<notice>当Episode.N.EpisodeType为Resource时，本参数才有用。
</notice>
         
TimeFirst：时间优先，直播类视频源只允许采用时间优先。 
ContentFirst：内容优先
fields.name: switch_type

parameters.help_en:
The production studio ID.

If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html, check the CasterId value returned by the CreateCaster operation.

If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, navigate to ApsaraVideo Live console > Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio to view the production studio name.

The production studio name in the production studio list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台路径查看导播台名称。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id
